note: No fact: the account of the police's periodic forum in Omdurman (held the Tuesday before publication, 2026-06-10 being a proxy date) names no station record system. It states that 103 police facilities were damaged or destroyed in the war, that about 70% of the post-war plan's targeted programmes and projects were carried out, that the 2024-2030 plan has a 'development of digital systems' project it does not describe, and that restored police databases served administrative and financial matters.
